def test_consumer_entry_has_fifteen_domains_one_explicitly_supported_topic(self):

        self.assertIn('QuestionDomain(id:"health"',self.swift)
        self.assertEqual(self.swift.count('enabled:true'),2)
        self.assertIn('topic.canCast && WenguaCastTimePlan.supports(topic.id)',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('self.topic=nil',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('WenguaCloudWelcomeScreen',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('chosenTopic',self.journey)
        self.assertIn('chosenDomain',self.journey)
        self.assertNotIn('if nativeChart == nil {showAsk=true}',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('WenguaPreparationCard(topic:topic) {showAsk=true}',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('guard let chart=nativeChart else {return []}',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('WenguaCivilClockWheel(clock:$draftClock',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('TimeZone.current.identifier',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('column("年",value:yearBinding',self.swift)
        self.assertNotIn('DisclosureGroup(section.title)',self.swift)
        self.assertNotIn('古籍断词 · V3.9.1',self.swift)
        self.assertIn('id="domain" class="screen on"',self.html)
        self.assertIn('id="domain-options"',self.html)
        self.assertIn('id="topic-options"',self.html)
        self.assertIn('class="brand-mark"',self.html)
        self.assertIn('class="reading-section"',self.html)
        self.assertNotIn('正反证据同列',self.html)
        self.assertNotIn('V3.9.1 · 文字断词',self.html)
